| # Object 0x1A00 to 0x1A07 transmit PDO mapping parameters {#object-0x1a00-to-0x1a07-transmit-pdo-mapping-parameters-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                            |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object contains the mapping for the PDOs the device is able to transmit.

###   {#section .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid; margin: 0 0 0 0;"}

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Index                             | 0x1A00 to 1A07                    |
+===================================+===================================+
| Description                       | TPDO x Mapping parameter          |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Object Code                       | RECORD                            |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Data Type                         | PDO Mapping                       |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Category                          | Conditional;                      |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | mandatory for each supported PDO  |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+

 

 

SubIndex Supported

 

+-----------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| SubIndex                          | 0                                           |
+===================================+=============================================+
| Description                       | Number of mapped application objects in PDO |
+-----------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| Access                            | RW(Dynamic mapping supported)               |
+-----------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| Default Value                     | 0                                           |
+-----------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| Range                             | 0: deactivated                              |
|                                   |                                             |
|                                   | 1-64: activated                             |
+-----------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+

 

  SubIndex        1h-8h
  --------------- ---------------------------------------------------------
  Description     PDO mapping for the nth application object to be mapped
  Access          RW
  Default Value   0x00000000
  Range           UNSIGNED32

 

 

SubIndex 1h - 8h Entry definition

 

  ------------- ------- ---------- ---------------
  Bits          31-16   15-8       7-0
  Description   Index   SubIndex   Object length
  ------------- ------- ---------- ---------------
